title: Ferritin and iron test
what: A blood test from a vein. It shows how much iron is in your blood now, and how much iron your body has stored.
why: For weakness, pale skin, hair loss, low hemoglobin, during pregnancy, and while you take iron treatment.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually in 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: If you take iron tablets or vitamins with iron. The doctor will say if you need a break
If you were recently ill, had a fever, or inflammation. This can change your ferritin
If you recently had a blood transfusion or an iron drip

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually the test is done in the morning on an empty stomach: no food for 8 to 12 hours. You can drink water.

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: It is best to come before 10 or 11 in the morning. Iron levels in the blood change during the day.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: No alcohol, no fatty food, and no hard workouts.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop iron tablets on your own. Tell your doctor. They will decide if you need a break before the test.

steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tied above your elbow and the skin is cleaned
Blood is taken from a vein into a tube
A cotton pad or a plaster is put on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a mosquito bite
If you feel dizzy, say so and you can lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes to avoid a bruise
You can eat and go back to your day right away
Your doctor will explain the result. Ferritin alone is not enough for a diagnosis

faq.q: Do I need to stop iron before the test?
faq.a: Do not stop on your own. Sometimes the doctor asks for a break of a few days to see your real level. Ask your doctor.

faq.q: Why is my ferritin high if my iron is low?
faq.a: Ferritin goes up with any inflammation or a cold. So the doctor looks at it together with other tests.

reminders.text: Iron test tomorrow morning. Do not eat after dinner. You can drink water.
